caption: Caribou bull in summer velvet. Tall rack with a shovel over the face, white neck mane, brown coat. Cows grow antlers too.
author: Denali National Park and Preserve
cardBack: Caribou bull: big rack with a shovel over the face, white neck mane. Cows carry antlers too, so antlers alone never mean bull.
cardDeck: Photo ID: mountain game and predators

caption: Wood bison in Wood Buffalo National Park. Tall hump, dark coat, massive forequarters, bearded head.
author: Ansgar Walk
cardBack: Bison: massive forequarters, a hump, a bearded head and short black horns. Wood bison: taller hump and darker than plains bison.
cardDeck: Photo ID: mountain game and predators

caption: Plains bison bulls in Yellowstone in snow. Next to a wood bison the hump is lower and the front end hair is longer and shaggier.
author: Yellowstone National Park from Yellowstone NP, USA

caption: Cougar, Grand Teton National Park. Light brown coat, compact head and a long heavy tail, about a third of the body, with a black tip.
author: National Park Service
cardBack: Cougar: light brown cat, compact head, long heavy tail with a black tip. Any cougar with spots is a kitten: protected, and so is any cougar with it.
cardDeck: Photo ID: mountain game and predators

caption: Cougar kitten. The spots mark it as a kitten: you may not hunt it, or any cougar in its company.
author: Santa Monica Mountains National Recreation Area

caption: Grey wolf in Yellowstone. Long legs, big feet, broad muzzle. BC wolves weigh 30 to 50 kg. At 200 m a big dog can look like this.
author: Yellowstone National Park from Yellowstone NP, USA
cardBack: Grey wolf: 30 to 50 kg, long legs, big feet, broad muzzle, tail carried out behind when running. Rule out a dog before you shoot.
cardDeck: Photo ID: mountain game and predators

caption: Coyote in Yosemite. 9 to 23 kg, against 30 to 50 kg for a BC wolf: slim pointed muzzle, tall ears, small feet, bushy tail.
author: Yathin S Krishnappa
cardBack: Coyote: 9 to 23 kg (a wolf is 30 to 50 kg). Slim pointed muzzle, tall ears, small feet, bushy black tipped tail carried low.
cardDeck: Photo ID: mountain game and predators

caption: Canada lynx near Whitehorse, Yukon. Long black ear tufts, huge furry paws, long legs, grey coat, short tail with a fully black tip.
author: kdee64 (Keith Williams)
cardBack: Canada lynx: long ear tufts, huge furry paws, long legs, grey coat with few markings, short tail with a fully black tip.
cardDeck: Photo ID: mountain game and predators

caption: Bobcat, California. Spotted tan coat, black bars on the front legs, short ear tufts, short tail black on top and white underneath.
author: Joyce Cory on Flickr as docentjoyce
cardBack: Bobcat: spotted tan coat, black bars on the front legs, short ear tufts, tail black on top only with a white underside. A lynx has huge furry paws and a fully black tail tip.
cardDeck: Photo ID: mountain game and predators

caption: Wolverine. Heavy, low slung, dark brown body with a pale band along the side, bushy tail, big claws. No season in Region 3: seasons only in Regions 6, 7A and 7B, bag limit 1, with a Compulsory Report.
author: USFWS Mountain-Prairie
cardBack: Wolverine: heavy, low slung, dark brown body, pale band along the side, bushy tail. No Region 3 season; seasons only in Regions 6, 7A and 7B, bag limit 1, Compulsory Report.
cardDeck: Photo ID: mountain game and predators

caption: Snowshoe hare in its brown coat, Banff. Grey brown body, dark ear tips, big dark eye.
author: Martin Kraft

caption: Snowshoe hare in its white winter coat. Look at the huge furred hind feet: the snowshoes.
author: D. Gordon E. Robertson
cardBack: Snowshoe hare: huge furred hind feet; grey brown in summer, white in winter; black ear tips.
cardDeck: Photo ID: mountain game and predators

caption: Surf scoter drake. Black body, white forehead patch, swollen orange, white and black bill: the skunk head.
author: Chuck Homler, Focus On Wildlife
cardBack: Surf scoter drake: all black, white patches on the forehead and nape, swollen orange and white bill. The skunk head.

caption: White winged scoter drake, Kodiak Island, Alaska. White teardrop at the eye; the white wing patch just shows on the water.
author: David Menke
cardBack: White winged scoter drake: the biggest scoter, white teardrop at the eye, white wing patch that shows in flight.

caption: Black scoter drake. All black, with a bright yellow orange knob on the bill.
author: Peter Massas
cardBack: Black scoter drake: all black with an orange knob on the bill. The female is dark with a pale face.

caption: Long tailed duck drake in winter plumage, in flight. Long pointed tail, bold black and white pattern, solid dark wings.
author: Dominic Sherony
cardBack: Long tailed duck drake: long pointed tail, bold black and white pattern that changes with the season, solid dark wings in flight.

caption: Harlequin drake (front) and hen. Drake slate blue with white stripes and chestnut sides; hen dark brown with white face spots. Limit 2 a day, 6 in possession.
author: peggycadigan
cardBack: Harlequin duck: small; drake slate blue with white stripes and chestnut sides, hen dark brown with white face spots. Limit 2 a day, 6 in possession.

caption: Common eider drake, Iceland. A heavy northern duck of the Arctic and Atlantic, not a BC bird: the BC federal table has no eider line. A sighting, not a target.
author: Hobbyfotowiki
cardBack: Common eider drake: heavy duck, white back and breast, black belly and cap, long sloping bill. Not a BC bird and no eider line in the BC federal table: a sighting, not a target.
